voice: English, US neutral single narrator; dramatic ~1.0–1.1x conversational; time-stretching only if absolutely needed and approved; align timings to actual recorded audio
subtitles: zh-TW provisional; SRT MUST be realigned after final voice recording
visual: Restrained cyber thriller; near-black navy, steel cyan, amber insight; red only for actual error. Precise geometry and typography, no fake leaks.

safe_area_px.note: Conservative production guide, not official YouTube UI specification. Check real device.

technical_note: HyperFrames first-party Three.js adapter listed as planned/experimental in public docs: use tested custom seek-driven frame adapter or prerender Three.js footage and composite with HyperFrames/GSAP.
factual_guardrails: 17.3 trillion is a metadata-derived estimate of potentially reachable rows, NOT extracted records
Do not show actual employee/user data, tokens, credentials, private API endpoints, or genuine Microsoft dashboards

Use a small on-screen dramatization disclosure and provide original Faav blog URL in description

shots.title: LOCKED FRONT DOOR
shots.vo: Microsoft's front door said: VPN required.
shots.zh: Microsoft 的入口寫著：需要 VPN。
shots.camera: Slow 6% dolly-in toward immense gunmetal vault, perfectly centered vertical symmetry
shots.visual: Black frame to cold-blue security monolith. Only one slit of cyan light; no hacker cliché.
shots.fx: Sub-bass pressure wave + one dry metallic thunk, low drone enters
shots.runtime: Three.js real geometry; SVG/UI typography above render
shots.notes: Dramatization of actual VPN restriction on Titan FRONTEND, not a screenshot.

shots.title: THE SIDE ENTRANCE
shots.vo: But a public API was still listening.
shots.zh: 但另一個公開 API 仍可連線。
shots.camera: Slow orbit 30 degrees around vault edge, revealing an unguarded glowing side port
shots.visual: A thin amber signal travels outside the sealed front door toward a small server socket.
shots.fx: Filtered network ping emerges from the right channel; low mechanical scrape
shots.runtime: Three.js camera and geometry; HyperFrames overlaid label
shots.notes: API was externally reachable; do not imply there was no authentication.

shots.title: AI FINDS A LEAD
shots.vo: An AI agent found the lead for a sixteen-year-old researcher.
shots.zh: 一名 16 歲研究者的 AI 代理找到了線索。
shots.camera: Match-cut side port into elegant network graph, then glide past floating archived document edges
shots.visual: Precise subdomain node geometry. One file marked ARCHIVED CONFIG; tiny 56 ROUTES/SOURCES not literal if inaccurate: display 56 TABLE DEFINITIONS only.
shots.fx: Three minimalist sonar chirps and fine paper-shift
shots.runtime: GSAP/SVG for network lines and text; Three.js only for camera-depth environment
shots.notes: Antares discovered public endpoint; archived Superset config contained 56 table definitions.

shots.title: TEN DAYS OF ERRORS
shots.vo: For ten days, it chased error messages, one security check at a time.
shots.zh: 接下來十天，AI 不斷追查每一道驗證錯誤。
shots.camera: Three precise rhythmic whip pans between laser-cut translucent panels, then decelerate
shots.visual: Fields illuminate one by one; each panel shows a sanitized rejection icon. No spinning terminal text.
shots.fx: Tick—tick—tick at 80 BPM, bass harmonic rises
shots.runtime: SVG typographic panels + GSAP easing; Three.js parallax
shots.notes: Actual service inspected JWT claims but failed to authenticate signature.

shots.title: THE MISSING SIGNATURE
shots.vo: The server inspected the token's claims—but never verified its signature.
shots.zh: 伺服器檢查了 Token 欄位，卻沒驗證簽章。
shots.camera: Single deliberate dolly lateral across three suspended glass layers; rack-focus onto empty signature socket
shots.visual: Header glass and Payload glass glow; final SIGNATURE chamber physically empty, unlatching in silence.
shots.fx: All rhythmic ticks abruptly stop at 22.0s; tiny high metallic harmonic remains
shots.runtime: Three.js translucent layers and volumetric spot; exact letterforms rendered in HTML/SVG
shots.notes: Use non-actionable placeholder JWT visuals; DO NOT show production endpoint or real keys.

shots.title: THE WRONG ASSUMPTION
shots.zh: 但每個看似正常的使用者名稱都失敗了。
shots.camera: Camera subtly pushes down endless corridor of identical error cards
shots.visual: Email-shaped identities fold to dark cards; one solitary cursor waits below.
shots.fx: Short dry rejection taps; music drops toward zero from 28.7s
shots.runtime: DOM/SVG cards with GSAP; optional Three.js shallow-depth corridor

shots.title: ONE HUMAN HUNCH
shots.vo: Then the researcher tried one word: admin.
shots.zh: 最後，研究者親自試了一個字：admin。
shots.camera: Locked-off intimate desk composition, 2% creeping push; cursor blinks then four letters appear
shots.visual: One anonymous figure in darkness, only keyboard edge and fingertip implied; large perfectly upright admin text.
shots.fx: 0.65s carefully placed near-total silence before the final key; single intimate keystroke
shots.emotion: Maximum anticipation and identification with insight
shots.runtime: Three.js desk/lighting; HTML monospace overlays + deterministic cursor via frame count
shots.notes: Human researcher hypothesized local username mapping; no depiction of actual Faav identity.

shots.title: QUERY RETURNS ONE
shots.zh: 查詢成功，結果只回傳一個數字：1。
shots.camera: Hard cut to absolute stillness; slow micro push on one bright digit
shots.visual: White numeral 1 in center, tiny caption QUERY EXECUTED AS LOCAL ADMIN.
shots.fx: One deep subdued impact, tail held; no victory fanfare
shots.emotion: Payoff: a quiet success is scarier than alarm
shots.runtime: SVG text in DOM; Three.js cinematic room behind
shots.notes: 1 depicts bounded proof-of-execution SELECT 1 result, not 17 trillion records returned.

shots.title: UNIMAGINABLE SCALE
shots.vo: Beyond it were seventeen databases, with an estimated seventeen point three trillion stored rows potentially reachable.
shots.zh: 背後有 17 座分析資料庫，估計涉及 17.3 兆筆可觸及資料列。
shots.camera: Unbroken fast-to-slow crane pullback revealing exactly 17 illuminated data towers receding into darkness
shots.visual: Repeated precision-grid architecture. Count stabilizes at 17.3T; data abstraction, never actual personal records.
shots.fx: Low-frequency expansion + granular swells; all music ducks while title holds >=3s
shots.emotion: Awe without implying actual mass leak
shots.runtime: Three.js instanced meshes; DOM numbers and disclosures; deterministic particles via seed
shots.notes: Value is metadata-derived potential exposure, NOT leaked/downloaded records; preserve qualifier in frame.

shots.title: RESPONSIBLE DISCLOSURE
shots.vo: He checked limited samples, then reported the flaw.
shots.zh: 他只做有限度驗證，隨後通報漏洞。
shots.camera: Elegant reverse dolly from infinite data towers back into tiny report envelope on dark desk
shots.visual: Warm neutral white over soft blue. A single minimalist outlined REPORT SUBMITTED emblem; no fake email screenshot.
shots.fx: Tension bass resolves to a clean percussive pulse; pen-on-paper foley
shots.runtime: GSAP mask transition + Three.js depth; SVG proof/status
shots.notes: Researcher used bounded samples and metadata; no full data dumping shown.

shots.title: ENDPOINT RESTRICTED
shots.vo: Microsoft restricted the endpoint, and awarded five thousand dollars.
shots.zh: Microsoft 限制 API 存取，並核發 5,000 美元賞金。
shots.camera: Two measured lateral moves: security shutter closes; award date appears without triumph confetti
shots.visual: Cold portal fades to secure outline. Understated MSRC timeline cards, illustrative not official Microsoft notice.
shots.fx: One definite latch; pulse decelerates and nearly vanishes
shots.runtime: Three.js door closing; GSAP precise date cards
shots.notes: Microsoft restricted endpoint on Sep 9 according to researcher; $5,000 award Sep 17.

shots.title: THE LAST QUESTION
shots.vo: It checked the claims. Not the signature.
shots.zh: 系統檢查了欄位，卻沒有驗證簽章。
shots.camera: Return to identical front-door framing from S01; stop exactly before resolving scanner light
shots.visual: The signed-ID slot is empty; tiny amber pin of light where a signature should be. Last frame matches opener.
shots.fx: Whispered high harmonic; final 0.4s near silence for seamless scroll-loop
shots.runtime: Three.js reused S01 camera and assets; GSAP terminal slate
shots.notes: Final moral is verification of identity proof, not distrust of JWT technology itself.
